searchText: looking at this and have a couple of questions: * should we introduce new `ExecutionPayloadV*` type and `NewPayloadV*` api method which incorporate BALs? Seems to me like the answer would be yes. * in the engine API, should we specify the BAL as being RLP-encoded? IMO yes as it's more efficient in both size and decoding speed than json. Yeah, we'd bump the request version and re RLP, the BAL is treated just like the transactions object now: From the engine api specs: ```python | Name | SSZ equivalent | Description | | ----------------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- | | `BlockAccessList` | `ByteList[MAX_BYTES_PER_TRANSACTION]` | RLP encoded block access list | ``` Created an execution-apis draft here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/compare/main...nerolation:execution-apis:eip-7928 <@427903869226582018> cool. I've made the changes to the miner and the engine API in Geth. So theoretically, Geth should be ready to go for an initial devnet. excerpts.content:
looking at this and have a couple of questions:
* should we introduce new `ExecutionPayloadV*` type and `NewPayloadV*` api method which incorporate BALs?  Seems to me like the answer would be yes.
* in the engine API, should we specify the BAL as being RLP-encoded?  IMO yes as it's more efficient in both size and decoding speed than json.

excerpts.author: nero_eth
excerpts.content:
Yeah, we'd bump the request version and re RLP, the BAL is treated just like the transactions object now:
From the engine api specs:
```python
| Name              | SSZ equivalent                        | Description                   |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `BlockAccessList` | `ByteList[MAX_BYTES_PER_TRANSACTION]` | RLP encoded block access list |
```
